g.text: Mazda 3 - CMU connector 0920-201B - wire side (viewed from behind), latch up
thick black border = thick power/GND wire | purple = ACC (2Q) | blue = B+ (2R) / LIN (2K) | green = RX (2T, next to blue B+) | white = TX (2S)
2A/2B/2G/2M empty in factory harness | 2S/2T only wired on bench (3.3V UART, 115200 8N1)
Original drawing by the mzd-toolkit project (CC0 1.0) | pin table: github.com/silverchris/mazda-cmu-documentation hardware.md (Sumitomo 6098-5611, unverified)
